promotion_rules.ci_to_runtime: all runtime and supply-chain runtime gates require immutable evidence refs bound to exact source SHA; public-repository runtime runners must also prove ephemeral/JIT single-job isolation
promotion_rules.cloudflare_connection_to_discovery: requires active account-scoped token, valid account id, jadeltechrd.com zone read, Tunnel API read, R2 API read and GET-only exact target-state discovery
promotion_rules.cloudflare_discovery_to_change_ready: requires explicit human change approval, exact source SHA, immutable cloudflared image digest, OpenBao tunnel-token handling, least-privilege Kubernetes identity, egress-only firewall proof, scoped R2 parent credential, temporary R2 credential proof, bucket-lock plan and rollback plan
promotion_rules.cloudflare_change_to_runtime_verified: requires real target resources plus tunnel HA/failover, R2 checksum roundtrip, retention enforcement, credential rotation and OTel evidence; configuration or CI success is insufficient
promotion_rules.runtime_to_production: requires separate safety, quality, SLO, DR and sustained-operation evidence
